bazi.explanation: Your BaZi chart is formed by four pillars: Year, Month, Day, and Hour. The Day Stem, known as your Day Master, is the core of the chart.
bazi.core_text: Your Day Master is {{dayMaster}}, suggesting a naturally stronger orientation toward action, judgment, and how you engage with the world.
bazi.chat_prefill: Based on my Four Pillars chart and Day Master {{dayMaster}}, what should I pay attention to right now?
bazi.element_summary: Your elemental structure is led by {{topElement}}, showing natural strength in {{topTerm}}, while {{weakestElement}} is comparatively weaker and may require more conscious balancing.
bazi.tension_two: Your structure emphasizes both {{top1}} and {{top2}}. This often creates a tension between momentum and control: you want to move quickly, but also want things to be precise and right.
bazi.tension_one: You tend to move forward through {{top1}}, but the {{weakest}}-related capacity for reflection, absorption, or regulation may not be as strong. You may move fast without fully processing as you go.
bazi.tension_balanced: Your elemental profile is relatively balanced, without one overwhelmingly dominant force. The advantage is flexibility, but the tension is that in important moments, you may need to consciously choose how you want to act rather than relying on one natural default.

mbti.key_insight_text: You work best when you can clarify the facts, then make a steady and practical decision.
mbti.chat_cta: Want to explore your MBTI more?
mbti.chat_prefill: Based on my {{type}} personality, what should I pay attention to when making decisions?
mbti.explanation: MBTI describes your preferences, not your limits. It helps reveal how you take in information, make decisions, and respond under pressure.
mbti.profile_text: Your personality profile shows a strong {{profileCode}} structure, favoring stability, practicality, rationality, and controlled decision-making.
mbti.inner_tension_text: You tend to rely on structure, standards, and certainty when making decisions, but reality is not always clear or controllable. This creates an inner tension between your desire for order and the need to navigate ambiguity and change.
mbti.impact_text: In daily life, you tend to perform best in environments with clear expectations and defined responsibilities, where your judgment and consistency can show up fully. In more uncertain situations, you may need to consciously relax the need to have the answer too early.
mbti.cross_link_text: Want to see how your MBTI and BaZi combine to reveal your unique pattern?

E.label: E (Extroversion)
E.meaning: Tends to gain energy through interaction and external stimulation, with a more direct and outward style.

I.label: I (Introversion)
I.meaning: Tends to restore energy in quieter environments, valuing inner rhythm and depth of focus.

S.label: S (Sensing)
S.meaning: Starts from concrete facts, details, and lived experience rather than abstract assumptions.

N.label: N (Intuition)
N.meaning: Starts from patterns, context, and future possibilities, valuing direction and imagination.

T.label: T (Thinking)
T.meaning: Makes decisions through logic, consistency, and analysis rather than emotional tone itself.

F.label: F (Feeling)
F.meaning: Makes decisions through values, relational impact, and inner alignment.

J.label: J (Judging)
J.meaning: Prefers to create order early, make decisions sooner, and move within a manageable rhythm.

P.label: P (Perceiving)
P.meaning: Prefers openness and flexibility, adjusting as circumstances change.

about.title: About Oria
about.subtitle: Eastern Metaphysics × Western Psychology
about.p1: Oria is a self-reflection app that combines BaZi, MBTI-style personality insight, and AI-assisted conversation to help you understand your current situation more clearly.
about.p2: Many people do not need someone to tell them exactly what to do. They need a clearer way to see what is happening.
about.p3: Oria was created for moments when life feels uncertain — when you are thinking about work, relationships, direction, timing, or personal change.
exploreItems: What kind of energy you naturally carry
What situations may support or drain you
How you tend to make decisions
What patterns appear in your relationships
What today's or this month's guidance may suggest
What question may be worth asking next
about.beliefHighlight: See the current situation more clearly, and make wiser choices.
about.beliefBody: Oria helps you look at yourself and your situation from another angle, so you can make decisions with more awareness.
about.notP1: Oria is not a professional advisory service. The content in Oria is for self-reflection, personal insight, and entertainment.
about.notP2: It should not be treated as medical, psychological, legal, financial, or emergency advice. For important decisions involving health, safety, money, legal matters, or mental health, please consult a qualified professional.

howItWorks.title: How Oria Works
howItWorks.p1: Oria combines BaZi, MBTI-style personality insight, and AI-assisted conversation to help you reflect on your current situation.
howItWorks.p2: Oria does not decide your life for you. It gives you another lens to understand patterns, timing, personality, and possible directions.
howItWorks.usesIntro: To generate your personal insights, Oria may use:
usesItems: Your MBTI result or personality answers
Your questions and conversation history inside Oria
helpsItems: Reflect on your strengths and friction points
See timing or energy around a situation
Prepare for decisions with more calm and clarity
howItWorks.cannotIntro: Oria does not predict the future with certainty. Oria does not replace:
useWellItems: Enter your birth information as accurately as possible
Choose the focus area that matches your real concern
Ask specific questions when chatting with Oria
Treat the result as reflection, not instruction
Use your own judgment before making important decisions
howItWorks.reminderBody: Oria offers insight, not fate. Your choices still belong to you.

debate.title: East-West Analysis
debate.headline: Got a question that's puzzling you?
debate.tagline: It doesn't have to be perfect — just say it
debate.subtitle: Enter your question and choose your Eastern and Western advisor models. Your chosen Eastern model, acting as an advisor with deep knowledge of Eastern metaphysics, will analyse your character, life direction and timing based on your BaZi data. Your chosen Western model, acting as an advisor with expertise in psychological analysis, will explore your mental patterns and behavioural style based on your MBTI results. Both will engage in four rounds of deep exchange — Insight, Timing, Risk, and Action — before Oria's AI synthesises both perspectives to provide personalised insights and recommendations.
